post_call_extraction_draft_v17.name: booking_succeeded
post_call_extraction_draft_v17.rule: True only after book_appointment_cal returns success and Isabella confirms the booking; false for a failed or incomplete booking; empty when no booking was attempted.

post_call_extraction_draft_v17.name: sms_consent_granted
post_call_extraction_draft_v17.rule: True only after the post-booking consent question receives a clear affirmative answer; false only for a clear decline; otherwise empty.

post_call_extraction_draft_v17.name: sms_consent_evidence
post_call_extraction_draft_v17.rule: Quote or closely transcribe the SMS consent question and caller response; otherwise empty.

notes: V15 remains the latest published Retell version. The live inbound phone was observed pinned to V16 Draft before V1.1 work began and is not changed by this draft.
V17 is the isolated V1.1 draft. It keeps Cimo, speed 1.12, temperature 1.0, and volume 1.0 because no tested setting change demonstrated a clear improvement. It is not assigned to the live phone.
No transfer function is attached. The previously documented destination is unverified, so the draft uses message-taking as the safe fallback.
The stale Wonder Knowledge Base remains detached from V15, V16, and the V17 draft.

Coffee Shop and no-background audio variants were exercised previously, and a short V17 Static Noise sample was generated. No background sound is retained because no ambience option demonstrated a clearer or more professional result than None.
Cimo does not support Retell pronunciation dictionaries. V1.1 uses concise handbook guidance plus the boosted keyword Wondora for the Won-Dor-Ah pronunciation.
